2.324 DataSets
The DataSets element contains an ordered list of DataSet elements for a Report. If the value of the
DataSource.Transaction property of the DataSource that is referenced in the DataSet.Query is true,
the execution order MUST follow the order of the datasets as they are specified in the report for all
datasets that use the same DataSource.
The following are the parent and child elements of the DataSets element.
Parent elements
Report
Child elements
DataSets.DataSet
The following is the XML Schema definition of the DataSets element.
 <xsd:complexType name="DataSetsType">
   <xsd:sequence>
     <xsd:element name="DataSet" type="DataSetType" maxOccurs="unbounded" />
   </xsd:sequence>
   <xsd:anyAttribute namespace="##other" processContents="skip" />
 </xsd:complexType>
2.324.1
DataSets.DataSet
The DataSets.DataSet element specifies a DataSet in the collection of DataSets for a Report. The
DataSets.DataSet element is of type DataSet.
Following is the parent element of the DataSets.DataSet element.
Parent elements
DataSets
The following is the XML Schema definition of the DataSets.DataSet element.
 <xsd:element name="DataSet" type="DataSetType" maxOccurs="unbounded" />
